method_evidence.quote_en: uniformly handles UHD video dehazing, deraining, denoising, and low-light enhancement tasks

transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 可将退化条件循环嵌入与循环迭代机制迁移至海上船舶图像增强，需将退化类型从通用去雾/去雨扩展到海雾、雨雪、低光等海事退化，并适配船舶目标区域的重建目标。

e4e7ece53146919260e52feb1c926aacc3056f12.title: Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection

method_evidence.quote_en: DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 基于置信度与相似度构建显式顺序，并用RNN沿该顺序细化查询以建模解码器内部竞争

method_evidence.quote_en: This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 有序循环细化减少冗余预测、稳定优化并提升检测精度

transfer_path.source_quote_en: turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 可将DETRNN即插即用模块迁移至DETR式船舶检测器，将无序查询转为竞争感知序列并用RNN细化；需在海事船舶数据上重新训练，调整置信度-相似度排序阈值以适配船舶密集小目标场景。

limitations: 仅在陆上通用检测基准验证，无海事船舶数据
未涉及跨模态或AIS关联
迁移依赖重新训练与参数调整
evaluation.reason_zh: DETR式检测查询有序细化方法可迁移至船舶检测，但缺少海事验证，相关性为陆上检测层面。

46ab4d266c59666b08232074565053ff4e5549fc.title: MGPO: Manifold-Guided Diffusion Alignment for Task-Aware Dataset Distillation

method_evidence.quote_en: The reward-modular design extends to structured tasks such as object detection and segmentation by substituting the frozen task reward model
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 奖励模块化设计通过替换冻结任务奖励模型可扩展到检测与分割等结构化任务

evaluation.reason_zh: 聚焦数据集合成蒸馏，检测分割仅为附带扩展，与船舶感知关联弱，无法具体说明迁移调整。

e7a60ed03dfec8d0b68ae447bc30950f58385dad.title: A Geometric-Transformation Feature-Adaptive Manifold Restoration Method for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images

method_evidence.quote_en: we propose original-view-anchored adaptive manifold repair (OAMR), which uses the original view as an anchor and reliable cross-view information to selectively repair locally unreliable visual features
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 以原始视角为锚，用可靠的跨视角信息选择性修复局部不可靠视觉特征。

method_evidence.quote_en: we develop pixel decoder test-time adaptation (PD-TTA) for SAM3, which fine-tunes only the parameters of the GroupNorm layers online during inference
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 推理时在线只微调GroupNorm层参数以适应样本级分布偏移。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: uses the original view as an anchor and reliable cross-view information to selectively repair locally unreliable visual features
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将D4旋转视角视为船舶图像的不同几何视角，以原始视角为锚，用跨视角可靠特征修复弱特征区域；需在船舶分割数据上替换SAM3提示/类别为船舶类，并评估近岸复杂背景下的稳定性。

limitations: 摘要未给出船舶或海事数据实验
D4视角不变性假设在海上场景（波浪、光照、尺度变化）未验证
仅微调GroupNorm的TTA对船舶域偏移是否有效未知
evaluation.reason_zh: 属于语义分割与多视角特征修复方法，可作为船舶分割的跨视角增强思路，但无海事验证且迁移需具体改造。

e7e2941607483d59e7d1aed2bc33940d06ea90ac.title: Task-Sensitive Geometry of Representation Transfer for Object Detection under Image Degradation

method_evidence.quote_en: We isolate a representation component complementary to direct clean-teacher alignment and map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 在干净教师蒸馏之外分离一个互补表征分量，并通过正交桥映射到学生空间。

method_evidence.quote_en: Controlled interventions rescue 13.22% of objects lost under the distilled representation, versus 4.30% under norm-matched random perturbations
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 受控干预可恢复蒸馏表征下丢失目标的13.22%，显著高于随机扰动。

method_evidence.quote_en: We introduce task-sensitive geometry, a gradient-derived channel-space geometry constructed from normalized detection-loss gradients
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 由归一化检测损失梯度构造通道空间的任务敏感几何。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将干净-退化图像对替换为清晰/雾浪退化海面船舶图像对，保留正交桥将互补表征迁入学生检测器；需调整教师-学生为船舶检测器并重定义退化类型与尺度。

limitations: 实验仅在BDD100K道路图像与Gaussian退化上进行
摘要明确路由规则与专用蒸馏目标未带来稳定增益
海事退化与船舶尺度分布未验证
evaluation.reason_zh: 退化图像检测与表征迁移方法具体，可迁移到海面退化下的船舶检测，但需替换数据与退化设定。

effdb038905a72120c64eebbf1bc967524303647.title: EagleDepth: Efficient Fine-Grained Depth Estimation via Pixel Diffusion Decoder

method_evidence.quote_en: retain depth-aware latent representations as guidance while generating the final depth map directly in pixel space
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 保留深度感知潜在表征作引导，同时在像素空间直接生成最终深度图。

method_evidence.quote_en: we adapt a pretrained pixel diffusion decoder, PiD, to predict depth conditioned on the learned features
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 改造预训练像素扩散解码器PiD，以学习特征为条件预测深度。

method_evidence.quote_en: The latent branch processes resized, lower-resolution RGB images, while the pixel branch generates depth at the target resolution, bypassing the original VAE decoder
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 潜在分支处理低分辨率图，像素分支在目标分辨率生成深度并绕过VAE解码器。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: The latent branch processes resized, lower-resolution RGB images, while the pixel branch generates depth at the target resolution, bypassing the original VAE decoder
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将RGB-深度配对替换为海事船舶RGB与深度数据，保留潜在引导+像素扩散解码结构以保留船体边界与桅杆等细结构；需重新微调潜在扩散模型与PiD解码器。

limitations: 摘要未涉海事数据或水面深度
多分辨率训练至4K的计算需求需评估
水面反光与稀疏纹理下的深度精度未知
evaluation.reason_zh: 船舶深度估计的直接任务相关，其潜在引导+像素扩散解码结构具体可迁移，但无海事验证。

96d12755e8f9d1793268ed172742ceff5aeafe14.title: Any-scale Object Detection using Arbitrary-scaled Images

method_evidence.quote_en: Our method suppresses these false positives by predicting scale proposal maps, each of which represents a set of pixels appropriate for each super-resolution scale
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 预测尺度提议图，为每个超分辨尺度给出适合的像素集合以抑制误检。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: predicting scale proposal maps, each of which represents a set of pixels appropriate for each super-resolution scale
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将尺度提议图用于船舶多尺度检测，按像素选择合适超分辨尺度以减少放大海面杂波产生的误检；需在船舶检测器上重新训练尺度提议分支。

limitations: 摘要极短，缺少实验与细节
未涉及海事场景或小目标船舶
超分辨引入的额外计算未评估
evaluation.reason_zh: 仅泛泛的尺度提议超分辨检测，方法细节与海事联系不足，迁移证据薄弱。

a8fd5477ef395e6537ead2c291013181d319849a.title: Depth Hypothesis Guided Iterative Refinement for Event-Image Monocular Depth Estimation

method_evidence.quote_en: By introducing a discrete Depth Hypothesis Volume (DHV), we transform the depth regression problem into a constrained depth search task.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 引入离散深度假设体，将深度回归转化为约束搜索问题，可用船舶深度估计。

method_evidence.quote_en: we construct a 3D cost volume between the DHV features and contextual features and perform a multi-scale correlation search to guide stable residual optimization
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 构建三维代价体并进行多尺度相关搜索以指导残差优化，可迁移到船舶深度。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: By introducing a discrete Depth Hypothesis Volume (DHV), we transform the depth regression problem into a constrained depth search task.

缺少与AIS关联或融合的内容
evaluation.reason_zh: 单目深度迭代细化方法可迁移到船舶深度估计，但无海事实验和AIS信息，证据有限。

327ecb29b7ae24cb991a41cd6df971e020fd7950.title: Dynamic Time Step Prediction in Inverse Heat Dissipation for Blur-Like Image Restoration Tasks

method_evidence.quote_en: we propose to implement a time predictor to estimate the starting time step for the inversion, with the model learning to adapt to the degradation severity

evaluation.reason_zh: 自适应扩散反演可用于船舶图像增强，但摘要未验证海事场景，迁移具体性一般。

0c1030cd6a9726cb2a3f4e3bafb991b6800a2055.title: VisionMX: Unlocking Microscaling Post-Training Quantization for Vision Models

evaluation.task_type: post-training microscaling quantization for vision models

method_evidence.quote_en: An analysis of direct conversion identifies three sources of error: block-scale representation, the poor alignment of some small convolutional weight tensors with nonuniform element grids, and the underuse of signed codes by nonnegative activations.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 分析MX直接转换的三类误差来源，可用于压缩船舶视觉模型时的量化误差诊断。

method_evidence.quote_en: optimizes bounded weight rounding and applies a foldable affine correction to activations
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 有界权重量化舍入与可折叠仿射激活校正，可迁移到船舶检测/分割模型量化。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: optimizes bounded weight rounding and applies a foldable affine correction to activations
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将训练后MX量化方法用于船舶检测网络，调整量化参数以适配检测骨干和头部，保持检测训练目标不变，仅做推理量化加速。

limitations: 摘要评估在通用视觉任务，未涉及船舶或海事数据
量化收益依赖具体架构，船舶检测模型需重新验证
无跨模态或AIS关联内容
evaluation.reason_zh: 视觉量化方法可迁移到船舶检测/分割轻量化，但无海事验证，相关性来自通用视觉任务。

f9121f3e079112456861ee469271dbc70e9c2d4f.title: Lightweight and Resource-Efficient Perception for Robotic Guide Dogs

evaluation.task_type: multi-sensor perception for robotic guide dogs

method_evidence.quote_en: We present complete on-device perception modules that fuse a 360 camera and a 2D LiDAR for reliable collision avoidance, with moving-object detection and tracking for human-centric guidance.
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 融合360相机与2D LiDAR的在线感知模块，含运动目标检测与跟踪，可为多传感器船舶感知提供参考。

method_evidence.quote_en: verification of fused 360 camera--LiDAR depth shows reliable near-range perception but inherent mid-range bias
method_evidence.interpretation_zh: 相机-LiDAR融合深度的近距可靠、中距偏差分析，对船舶多传感器深度估计有借鉴。

transfer_path.source_quote_en: We present complete on-device perception modules that fuse a 360 camera and a 2D LiDAR for reliable collision avoidance, with moving-object detection and tracking for human-centric guidance.
transfer_path.adaptation_zh: 将360相机与2D LiDAR融合架构改为船载相机与雷达/LiDAR融合，检测与跟踪目标改为船舶，调整传感器标定和融合参数。

limitations: 面向机器人导盲场景，非船舶或海事

evaluation.reason_zh: 多传感器相机-LiDAR融合与运动目标检测跟踪对船载多传感器检测有借鉴，但无海事验证。
